description: The pie chart represents the evaluation of speaker anonymization on emotional speech, with a total of six categories. The largest segment, colored in blue, represents Neutral at 25.1%. The second largest, in purple, is also Neutral at 23.1%. The third segment, in yellow, represents Anger at 14.9%. The fourth, in orange, is Excitement at 14.7%. The fifth segment, in red, represents Happiness at 14.1%. The smallest segment, in green, represents Anger at 8.1%. Each segment is labeled with its respective category and percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the slices. The segments are ordered by size, with Neutral being the largest and Happiness the smallest.
